original.name: equitabilise_aux
original.statement: a * m + b * (m + 1) = #s) : ∃ Q : Finpartition s, (∀ x : Finset α, x ∈ Q.parts → #x = m ∨ #x = m + 1) ∧ (∀ x, x ∈ P.parts → #(x \ {y ∈ Q.parts | y ⊆ x}.biUnion id) ≤ m) ∧ #{i ∈ Q.parts | #i = m + 1} = b
